free_parameters.name: model_cout
free_parameters.why: tiny fully-connected layer; the target decision only depends on the per-column Posit sizes

free_parameters.name: model_cin
free_parameters.why: input width of the toy layer; irrelevant to the channel-window size check

free_parameters.name: config_bits
free_parameters.why: midpoint between base_nsize and upgrade_nsize so one channel window is upgraded

free_parameters.name: base_nsize
free_parameters.why: default Posit size used by FlexPositConfig

free_parameters.name: upgrade_nsize
free_parameters.why: size of the upgraded channel window; distinct from base_nsize so a tile can span two sizes

free_parameters.name: posit_es
free_parameters.why: paper default exponent size, also used by the quantizer and export

free_parameters.name: sensitivity_window
free_parameters.why: the one upgraded output-channel window; makes columns 0,1 Posit(5) and columns 2,3 Posit(4)

free_parameters.name: n_columns
free_parameters.why: both inputs export two channels; only the window position differs

free_parameters.name: activations_fill
free_parameters.why: constant activation rows; activations are quantized after the target and do not affect the size check

execution.entry_reason: Step 4 reports call_chain_status=not_found: export_tile is a separate export-API function and quantize never calls it. The driver calls the official entry quantize first to build the QuantState that export_tile consumes, then calls export_tile on that state; the target therefore runs just after the entry returns, not inside it.
